nodes.label: Unit tests for article pipeline fixes: - C2: Pre-mortem correction application v
Minimal fake pipeline for testing article mixin methods.
When the reviser returns a genuinely different article, it should be saved.
When the reviser returns the same article, a stronger prompt should be tried.
When even the strong prompt returns unchanged text, warn and keep original.
When corrections list is empty, nothing should happen.
When article is empty, nothing should happen.
Retrieve Sources critical phase should fail when no sources retrieved.
Retrieve Sources critical phase should fail when evidence gate triggered.
Retrieve Sources critical phase should NOT fail when sources exist.
Adversarial Verify should fail when claim support is too low after retry.
Adversarial Verify should fail when no claims and no sources at all.
Adversarial Verify should NOT fail when claim support is adequate.
Unknown phase names should not trigger halting.
When spot-check returns 'rejected', the claim status should be downgraded to 'we
When spot-check returns 'verified', the claim status should stay 'verified'.
When no claims have 'verified' status, no spot-check calls should be made.
When deduped list is empty, no spot-check should run.
When the spot-check LLM call fails, the claim should remain verified and not cra
Articles under the word limit should not be truncated.
Articles over the word limit should be smart-truncated with notice.
Truncated output should stay near the max_words budget.
When style_brief has an author, the humanize prompt should include style constra
When style_brief is empty, the humanize prompt should not include style constrai
